basis: The chart displays an inverted y-axis where higher values (8) are at the bottom of the page and lower values (0) are at the top. The 'peak-burden' or highest mortality count corresponds to the data point positioned lowest on the visual chart. Visual inspection shows the line dips to its lowest vertical position at the far right, corresponding to the year 2018. This is confirmed by the independent visual notes which state the 2018 marker is at the lowest point on the page. Therefore, 2018 is the year with the peak burden.
option_label: Escalate 2018 for annual mortality peak follow-up
